name: Barbell Split Jerk
steps: Stand tall with a barbell resting across your front shoulders, hands just outside shoulder width, and feet hip-width apart.
Keep your torso upright and dip straight down a few inches by bending your knees smoothly.
Drive explosively upward through your legs, then split one foot forward and the other back as you punch your arms locked overhead.
Stabilize the bar overhead, recover your front foot then back foot to parallel, and lower the bar safely to your shoulders.
tips: Dip and drive vertically without pitching your chest forward or letting your elbows drop.
Land with your front shin vertical, rear heel lifted, and weight evenly split between both legs.
